column1: Two scholarship types: Merit scholarships (automatic consideration if a university offers one and you meet eligibility; a few universities require a separate application, notified by email around late April) and Regional scholarships (separate, need-based application covering family income/property; administered by the region's DSU/ERSU-type agency; applications typically open in June, dates vary by region).
